newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Idemitsu plans turnarounds at two refineries.
newsitem.headline: Japan Idemitsu plans turnarounds at two refineries.

text.p: Refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Friday it planned to shut crude distillation units at its Chiba and Hyogo refineries for about a month each this year for maintenance checks.
Idemitsu's 250,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) topper at the Chiba refinery, east of Tokyo, will be closed from around late April to late May, a company spokesman said.
Idemistu also plans to shut its 140,000 bpd topper at its refinery in Hyogo, central Japan, from around late August to late September, he said.
